features.name: Line jackpots

features.name: Collect symbol

review:
Elvis Frog heads to Hawaii in this sequel to Elvis Frog in Vegas. It's a 5x3, 25-line game, and the coins are the real show.

Six or more coins start a coin-only bonus with three respins – every new coin resets the counter and sticks until the end. Fill one, two or three full rows to win the Mini (20x), Major (100x) or Mega (1,000x), and a Collect symbol can grab the value of every coin on screen. Scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 trigger free spins. Medium-high volatility, 2,000x max – just note the RTP is a lower 94.98%.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
